content.summary: An adult night courier settles through three sleep micro-actions. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult identity remains fixed. + Micro-actions are individually observable and low amplitude. + Bedding and light preserve spatial continuity. + No dramatic dream event is inferred without evidence. + The terminal state returns to the same quiet baseline.
quick_start.recommended_input: Frame one clearly adult original animated night courier asleep on a navy cot beside one amber cabin lamp. Show one slow breath, a brief brow release and one fingertip relaxation as three bounded micro-actions. Hold the same sleeping posture for two final seconds with no new event, text or camera move.
